code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pH), leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential, suggesting significant respiratory and hematologic compromise. Elevated creatinine indicates possible acute kidney injury. High D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, and INR suggest systemic inflammation and coagulopathy. These findings are concerning for severe infection or sepsis with multi-organ involvement; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
